en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a historic Italian square framed by a large arch in the foreground. In the center stands a monumental fountain topped with a statue of Neptune holding a trident, surrounded by sculpted figures and basins. Behind it rises a large Romanesque cathedral with a rose window, arcaded façade, and octagonal dome with a cross on top. To the left are old stone buildings with shuttered windows and a crenellated tower. Small figures of pedestrians and an early automobile appear in the square. Handwritten-style text at the bottom reads the location and square name.
